linux.native_custom_main: two own-PID SIGINT modes; complete/missing synthetic terminal evidence, native monotonic time, sealed config/isolated child/Stop/actual exit

abi: No new FFI/ABI; ADR-0084 oracle not rerun.

windows.scope: Linux-only pump; prior native/portable checks still pending after automatic approval quota failure

limitations: No terminal foreground-group signals, native Ctrl+C, real VT, evdev/uinput, Hook/SendInput or driver operations.
Active drive lifetime is intentionally unbounded; stopping/fault observation is bounded five seconds, with owner retained on expiry and no deadline reset.
Actual exit is checked before observation expiry; only actual exit leads to terminal collection and signal guard closure.
Control errors use last accepted MonoTime and owned forced stop; separate std Instant elapsed bounds observation, not a worker lease or suspend proof.
Recovery waits use 5ms sleep to avoid repeatedly waiting on a failed signal endpoint. OS scheduling/syscall stalls are not proven bounded.
Emergency Drop orders child cleanup before mask restoration, but bounded Supervisor Drop does not prove exit or global recovery.
Synthetic terminal report facts validate transport/classification only, not actual Runtime/hardware recovery.
Cold host composition and run-linux CLI remain unimplemented; full cross-platform objective remains incomplete.
